title: Chicken Tacos
metaDescription: Seasoned chicken tacos with a smoky spice blend — juicy shredded or diced chicken, ready for taco night in 30 minutes.
author: Laura Bennett
keywords: chicken tacos, easy taco recipe, taco night dinner
ingredients: Shredded lettuce, diced tomato, shredded cheese, sour cream, for serving

steps.name: Season the chicken
steps.text: Toss diced chicken with chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder and a pinch of salt.

steps.name: Cook
steps.text: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken in a single layer and cook 7-8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through.

steps.name: Assemble
steps.text: Divide chicken among warmed tortillas. Top with lettuce, tomato, cheese and sour cream.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Serve with lime wedges for squeezing over the top.

tips.question: How do I warm tortillas without them cracking?
tips.answer: Warm them directly in a dry skillet for 20-30 seconds per side, or wrap a stack in foil and heat in a 300°F oven for 10 minutes — cold tortillas straight from the fridge are what crack when folded.

tips.question: Can I use ground chicken instead of diced breast?
tips.answer: Yes — ground chicken cooks faster (about 5-6 minutes) and works well with the same seasoning blend, just break it apart as it browns.

tips.question: Can I make the chicken ahead for meal prep?
tips.answer: Yes — the seasoned cooked chicken keeps in the fridge for up to 4 days, making it easy to assemble tacos fresh each night without recooking.

storyIntro: Taco night doesn't need much beyond well-seasoned chicken and a hot pan — the spice blend here does the heavy lifting, so there's no marinating required.
Diced chicken cooks fast and browns well, giving good texture without the wait of a whole seasoned chicken breast.
storyNote: Cook the chicken in a single layer without stirring too often — letting it sit in contact with the hot pan is what gives it browned edges instead of just steaming through.
